description: This file defines the class AssumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider, which provides AWS credentials by assuming a role with a web identity token. It includes methods for constructing the provider, loading credentials asynchronously, and handling token retrieval and errors.

classes.name: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider
classes.description: Credential provider class for assuming AWS roles with web identity tokens, handling token file reading, retries, and credential retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with configuration options, environment variables, and default values.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Asynchronously loads credentials by assuming a role with a web identity token, with retry and error handling.
